questions.stem: What is the sum of interior angles of a hexagon (6 sides)?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of an $n$-sided polygon is $(n - 2) \times 180°$. For a hexagon: $(6 - 2) \times 180° = 4 \times 180° = 720°$.

questions.stem: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is $40°$. How many sides does it have?
questions.explanation: The exterior angles of any convex polygon sum to $360°$. For a regular polygon, each exterior angle is equal, so the number of sides is $\frac{360°}{40°} = 9$.
